remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiu Notebooks. Pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 26, Orientation based on installation photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Oil on board', Georgia O'Keeffe museum has changed this to 'Oil on panel' based on examination by conservator Dale Kronkright (May, 2013) determining that the painting is on a wood panel support instead of on board.(Source: O'Keeffe Museum, 2025)

titles.title: Alligator Pears

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Two green pears rest on top of green fabric.  The tops of the pears point toward the lower left corner, and the upper pear lies slightly behind the lower pear.  Behind the fabric, much of the background is white; however, the background visible in the two upper corners is black.
